result.topic_en: A table of observations made at the observatory on 21 March 1836: times, alternating scale readings (turning points), their running means, the differences between them, and the mean of those differences, with temperatures recorded at the start and end.

methods.what: The turning-point readings are split into two series, one for each side of the swing. Each reading is compared with the arithmetic mean of its two neighbouring readings from the opposite side, e.g. 727.912 = (714.975+740.85)/2.
The difference between each reading and the interpolated mean of the opposite side gives the swing amplitude, e.g. 727.912 − 196.625 = 531.287.
The seven differences are averaged to give the mean amplitude, shown as the final total below the column.
